crossRefs.note: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons…

parallels.note: The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.
The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.

people.name: Kenan
people.line: Son of Enosh, descendant of Seth

people.name: Mahalalel
people.line: Descendant of Seth; ancestor of Noah

translations.web: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
translations.asv: and Kenan lived after he begat Mahalalel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
